name: computesdk-router
description: Run code in cloud sandboxes, manage CI workflows, check provider key status, and read benchmark results.

interface.longDescription: ComputeSDK Router gives your assistant a real execution environment: create sandboxes, run commands, manage files, run long-lived processes, and preview exposed ports. Sandboxes are placed across providers through the ComputeSDK gateway, on your own provider keys or ComputeSDK's managed accounts. Ask which providers and sizes are available before you create anything. It also drives the org's Actions CI (list repos and workflows, dispatch runs, watch progress, read job logs), shows provider key status, and reads benchmark results. Dispatching CI requires an org admin to connect repos via the ComputeSDK GitHub App first.
defaultPrompt: Which providers and sizes can I run sandboxes on?
Spin up a sandbox, write a small web server, and give me its preview URL.
Show me the latest failing CI run and pull the failing step's logs.
